items.title: Salesloft Takes Drift Offline After OAuth Token Theft Hits Hundreds of Organizations
items.description: Salesloft on Tuesday announced that it's taking Drift temporarily offline "in the very near future," as multiple companies have been ensnared in a far-reaching supply chain attack spree targeting the marketing software-as-a-service product, resulting in the mass theft of authentication tokens. items.title: Cloudflare Confirms Data Breach, Hackers Stole Customer Data from Salesforce Instances
items.description: Cloudflare has confirmed a data breach where a sophisticated threat actor accessed and stole customer data from the company’s Salesforce instance. The breach was part of a wider supply chain attack that exploited a vulnerability in the Salesloft Drift chatbot integration, affecting hundreds of organizations globally.
